title: GameMcpManifest
description: GameMCP server manifest: the 8 tools agents consume, with timeouts and policies (spec 05 section 3). Mirrored by mcp-gate/src/manifest.rs and asserted identical in tests.
name: game-studio-mcp

tools.name: scene.applyPatch
tools.policy: requires base_hash match + all 5 gates + human approve for non-local branches

tools.name: asset.import
tools.policy: lands in staging/blake3:<hash>/ + receipt.json; promotion via asset.reload only

tools.name: build.run
tools.policy: agents may pass --shaders-only and --tests-only; --release requires human role

tools.name: sim.replay
tools.policy: fixed seed + fixed dt; returns tick hash chain + mismatch index or OK

tools.name: render.screenshot
tools.policy: headless Lavapipe/SwiftShader allowed; native GPU screenshots are read-only

tools.name: script.check
tools.policy: deno/tsc or cargo check in sandbox; returns diagnostics JSON

tools.name: script.test
tools.policy: wasmtime fuel=10M, mem=64MiB, no net, epoch 50ms; returns traps as structured errors
